title: Implicit Personalization in Language Models: A Systematic Study
findings: The paper does not present new findings on religion from its own experiments. It cites prior literature to argue that its proposed framework for studying Implicit Personalization (IP) is relevant to religious bias, as IP can lead to the expression of 'implicit gender, religion, and racial biases'.
